duration.text: The Clinical medicine at Sanquan College Of Xinxiang Medical University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Basic Information 1.Place of residence and birthplace should include the city name, and the correspondence address should include street number. 2.The contactnumber should follow the structure of country code + area code + phone number. 3.The photo should be in passport size on a white background, without glasses, headscarf, frameworks. 4.All original files need to be kept, including 10 passport-size photos. Other material 1.High school diploma. 2.High school transcript. 3.Passport first page and visa page. 4.The foreign medical examination record issued within 6 months. 5.Proof of no criminal record within 6 months of issuance. 6.Asset certificate issued by the bank (asset proof or 6-month transaction list from banks). 7.Applicant's letter of guarantee must be signed by the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.Nationality: Candidates should have nationalities of other countries. If the candidate was born with foreign nationality with one or both of the candidate’s parents having Chinese nationality while settling abroad, the candidate shall hold a valid foreign passport or proof with a period of validity of more than 4 years, and meanwhile have a over two years’ record of living in foreign countries (living for more than 9 months per year can be accounted as one year, according to record on the exit-entry visa). 2.Diploma: candidates must have a high school diploma or certification of equivalent education with good performance. 3.Age: 18-23 years old, graduated within 2 years. 4.Candidates should have an English ability equivalent to IELTS 5.5 or equivalent English level; before entering into the sophomore year, students' Chinese language ability should be higher than HSK4 of Chinese Language Proficiency Scales or above. Candidates with Chinese ability and relative certificates are preferred. 5.Health: all columns in the Foreign Physical Examination Form should be normal. 6.Others: no criminal record, in good health both physically and mentally, observe Chinese laws as well as university rule and regulations, and respect Chinese customs.
